hook_text: Is 0,5 the same as 5%? Ten times no. Here is the trick.
clip_script: Market day in Mahikeng! The poster says 25% goes to the animal shelter. That is 0,25. That is one quarter. Three names, one number! The bridge is 100. 1/2 is 50/100: 0,5 and 50%. So 0,5 is not 5%. It is 50%! Now compare 3/5, 0,58 and 62%. Make them all decimals: 0,60, 0,58, 0,62. 62% wins! And 100 cupcakes at R4,50? Slide two places: R450.
visual_style: A colourful school market with stalls, a chocolate slab split into 100 squares, and labels flipping between fraction, decimal and percentage.
mood: Lively and friendly, like a market day announcer.
pacing: Quick hook, a steady reveal of the three forms, then fast comparisons.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and work out the market day profit.
